scope: All P1–P25 manuscripts, audits, synchronization, expansion, figures, tables, equations, citations, and experiments

1_empirical_numbers: Raw machine-readable experiment output / JSON / CSV logs
2_implementation_claims: Actual codebase source code (core/, infrastructure/, etc.)
3_mathematical_claims: First-principles mathematical derivations & metric geometry proofs
4_figures: Actual source data and matplotlib/tikz scripts
Actual rendered PDF visual bounding boxes
5_page_and_depth_claims: PyMuPDF native bounding-box continuous rendered-area integration
Strict distinction between Physical PDF pages and Substantive Body pages
Never rely on estimated word-count multiplier formulas
6_citations: Actual cited papers and verifiable bibliographic metadata
Direct relevance and explicit conceptual gap mapping

hard_stop_condition.release_criteria: SOURCE VERIFIED + DEFINITION VERIFIED + VALUE VERIFIED + PROVENANCE RECORDED
